mapper.sql: select v.id, v.product_key, v.device_id, v.iot_id, v.package_type, v.custom_type, v.module, v.current_version, v.target_version, v.hardware_version, v.last_task_id, v.last_status, v.protocol, v.retry_count, v.status_detail, v.ext_info, v.create_time, v.update_time, v.last_report_time, v.last_success_time, d.device_name from iot_ota_device_version v left join iot_device d on lower(d.product_key) = lower(v.product_key) and lower(d.device_id) = lower(v.device_id)
mapper.select: where v.product_key = #{productKey} order by v.last_report_time desc, v.id desc

select current_version as version, count(*) as count from iot_ota_device_version where product_key = #{productKey} and current_version is not null and current_version != '' group by current_version order by count(*) desc, current_version desc limit 10
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO iot_ota_device_version tgt USING ( SELECT #{productKey} AS product_key, #{deviceId} AS device_id, #{iotId} AS iot_id, #{packageType} AS package_type, #{customType} AS custom_type, #{module} AS module, #{currentVersion} AS current_version, #{targetVersion} AS target_version, #{hardwareVersion} AS hardware_version, #{lastTaskId} AS last_task_id, #{lastStatus} AS last_status, #{protocol} AS protocol, #{retryCount} AS retry_count, #{statusDetail} AS status_detail, #{extInfo} AS ext_info, #{lastReportTime} AS last_report_time, #{lastSuccessTime} AS last_success_time FROM dual ) src ON ( tgt.product_key = src.product_key AND tgt.device_id = src.device_id AND tgt.package_type = src.package_type AND NVL(tgt.module, 'APPLICATION') = NVL(src.module, 'APPLICATION') ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tgt.iot_id = src.iot_id, tgt.custom_type = src.custom_type, tgt.current_version = src.current_version, tgt.target_version = src.target_version, tgt.hardware_version = src.hardware_version, tgt.last_task_id = src.last_task_id, tgt.last_status = src.last_status, tgt.protocol = src.protocol, tgt.retry_count = src.retry_count, tgt.status_detail = src.status_detail, tgt.ext_info = src.ext_info, tgt.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, tgt.last_report_time = src.last_report_time, tgt.last_success_time = src.last_success_time WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( product_key, device_id, iot_id, package_type, custom_type, module, current_version, target_version, hardware_version, last_task_id, last_status, protocol, retry_count, status_detail, ext_info, create_time, update_time, last_report_time, last_success_time ) VALUES ( src.product_key, src.device_id, src.iot_id, src.package_type, src.custom_type, src.module, src.current_version, src.target_version, src.hardware_version, src.last_task_id, src.last_status, src.protocol, src.retry_count, src.status_detail, src.ext_info, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, src.last_report_time, src.last_success_time )
mapper.sql: select v.id, v.product_key, v.device_id, v.iot_id, v.package_type, v.custom_type, v.module, v.current_version, v.target_version, v.hardware_version, v.last_task_id, v.last_status, v.protocol, v.retry_count, v.status_detail, v.ext_info, v.create_time, v.update_time, v.last_report_time, v.last_success_time, d.device_name from iot_ota_device_version v left join iot_device d on d.product_key = v.product_key and d.device_id = v.device_id
